title: Smallerveins
description: Small mod that caps the Ore vein size to a set amount and allows to reduce spawn rate overall
body:
# SmallerVeins

A simple Minecraft mod that gives you more control over ore vein generation.
This project was made to give players an actual incentive to make farms/factories, not intended to be played on its own (you could definitely do that as well if you want to)

## Features
- **Limit vein size** – Cap the maximum size of all ore veins.
   From personal experience, Sizes smaller than 4 result in almost no ore veins at all, especially in caves, since most attempts there fail anyway
- **Reduce spawn chance** – Make ore veins generate less frequently

## Configuration
| Option | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `maxVeinSize` | 4 | 1–64 | Maximum size of any ore vein |
| `genChance` | 100 | 0–100 | Chance (%) that a vein generates at all |
